doctrine: Lane discipline. Each system has one role. Mergers blur authority and corrupt evidence.

rules.rule: FALCON shall not become a TRADER
rules.what_it_means: Falcon detects setups (eyes). Falcon does not place orders, manage positions, size risk, or call brokers. NON-EXECUTING BY DESIGN — production-grade through reliable observation, not through broker integration.

rules.rule: HELIOS shall not become a TRADER
rules.what_it_means: Helios advises alignment state (nervous map). Helios does not execute. Solo + Matt judge whether to act; Agent Smith executes when authorised.
rules.current_state: PASSING — V3 daemon source-confirmed 2026-05-03 has no broker code; recommends explicit tripwire parity with trader-xau-watcher

rules.what_it_means: Helios consumes Falcon's persisted output (helios_strategy_signals). Helios does not detect setups, does not import Falcon strategy modules, does not run worker.evaluate().
rules.tripwire: Helios source must not import from falcon.strategies.*

rules.what_it_means: ARES authors risk gate state (risk reflex). Helios advises alignment (nervous map). Two different decisions on two different systems.
rules.tripwire: ares:* keys may not contain decision/v3_tier/composite_confidence. helios:state:* may contain ares.gates as passthrough only — never authored by ARES.

rules.rule: R2D2 shall not become a TRADER
rules.what_it_means: R2D2 audits and backtests (auditor). R2D2 does not place orders, advise execution, override Solo. R2D2's outputs are evidence, not commands.
rules.tripwire: R2D2 fabric writes restricted to r2d2:* namespace. NO writes to falcon:*, helios:*, ares:*, trader:*, neo:* by R2D2 process.

rules.what_it_means: R2D2 may build PORTS of Falcon strategies for backtest replay (e.g. /srv/r2d2/scripts/csdr_session_sweep/csdr_engine.py — pure-Python port of CSDR state machine). Ports are AUDIT INSTRUMENTS — clearly labelled, never substitute Falcon's canonical implementation in production.
rules.tripwire: R2D2 strategy ports MUST include header docstring: 'AUDIT INSTRUMENT — NOT CANONICAL FALCON. Source of truth: /srv-dev/falcon/strategies/<plugin>/worker.py'. R2D2 must re-port (not patch) when canonical Falcon code changes.
rules.current_state: PARTIAL — csdr_engine.py exists; needs header annotation. Gatekeeper TODO.

rules.rule: R2D2 shall not own OUTCOME TRUTH
rules.what_it_means: Falcon's outcome_resolver.py (wick_aware method, architect-ratified WO-OUTCOME-RESOLVER-METHODOLOGY-0001 2026-04-29) is canonical for fire outcomes. R2D2 may audit disagreements (write to r2d2:audit:* namespace) but never substitute resolver truth in helios_strategy_signals.outcome_*.
rules.tripwire: R2D2 process must not UPDATE helios_strategy_signals.outcome_* columns

rules.rule: helios_strategy_signals despite the name IS OWNED BY FALCON
rules.what_it_means: Misleadingly-named legacy table from V2 era. Writers: Falcon signal_feed.py (canonical). Readers: Solo, Helios V3 daemon, NEO, R2D2 — all read-only. NO non-Falcon service may write to it.
rules.tripwire: DB GRANT audit: only Falcon's daemon user has INSERT/UPDATE on helios_strategy_signals. Helios V3 daemon user has SELECT only.
rules.future_consideration: Renaming to falcon_strategy_signals would be cleaner. Migration cost: 4+ consumer services + helios_v3_decisions backfill. See open_questions Q11 + Q16.
rules.current_state: PASSING — Helios V3 daemon SQL is SELECT only (source-confirmed)

rules.rule: NEO shall not become a TRADER
rules.what_it_means: NEO observes, scores, audits, coaches (apprentice). NEO never places live trades. NEO trades FTMO_PRACTICE_100K only (per shared_rule_neo_practice_only — Matt 2026-04-22). Promotion to higher authority requires explicit Matt rule.
rules.tripwire: NEO process broker connection must be FTMO_PRACTICE_100K only. Live broker connection forbidden by config.

rules.rule: PLUTUS is the SIMULATION ENVIRONMENT, not the production environment
rules.what_it_means: All training, replay, and what-if happens in PLUTUS (simulator). Live execution flows through Solo → Agent Smith → IBKR Live only. PLUTUS sim broker results never feed live decision systems.
rules.tripwire: trader:gate:composite production reads must never include plutus.* sources. PLUTUS state writes must never collide with live state keys.

rules.what_it_means: Solo reads helios_strategy_signals (or trader:gate:composite) and decides whether to execute. Solo does not author fires. Solo does not author Helios state.
rules.tripwire: Solo process must be read-only on helios_strategy_signals + helios:state:*. Solo writes only to its own trade-state namespace.

rules.what_it_means: ARES emits risk gate state (risk reflex). ARES does not detect setups (eyes). Falcon may READ ARES gate state observationally (in risk_context.ares_state) but ARES does not generate proposals.
rules.tripwire: ARES code must not import falcon.strategies.*. ARES outputs must be gate state only.

rules.rule: Agent Smith shall not become FALCON, HELIOS, or ARES
rules.what_it_means: Agent Smith executes broker operations (hands). Agent Smith does not detect, align, or veto. Agent Smith receives explicit authorisation from Solo/Matt and acts on it.
rules.tripwire: Agent Smith must not import falcon.strategies.*, helios_v3.*, or ares risk modules. Agent Smith reads execution intent only.
rules.current_state: UNRATIFIED — Agent Smith deployment topology in open_questions Q17

rules.rule: Ranger is a TRADE-MANAGEMENT MODULE, not a TRADER IDENTITY
rules.what_it_means: Ranger manages open-trade brackets when enabled. Ranger does not decide whether to enter or exit; Solo decides. Ranger is mechanical bracket lifecycle — not a separate persona, not a trader authority.
rules.tripwire: Ranger config must require explicit enablement by execution authority. Ranger must not place new entry orders — only modify existing brackets within authorised policy.

rules.rule: ARES live veto authority lives at TRADER-GATE-COMPOSITOR LEVEL only (architect doctrine 2026-05-03)
rules.what_it_means: ARES gate state may be SNAPSHOTTED by Falcon for explainability and READ by Helios V3 for context, but the LIVE EXECUTION VETO is the trader-gate-compositor's job. Falcon detects in any regime; Helios advises alignment; trader-gate-compositor + Solo decide whether risk environment supports action.
rules.tripwire: Falcon strategies must not decline purely because ARES = BLOCK (audit pending). Helios V3 daemon currently overrides decision to NO_GO when ARES BLOCK — DOCTRINE VS CODE MISMATCH (Q18 BLOCKING).
rules.current_state: DOCTRINE RATIFIED 2026-05-03; CODE VERIFICATION PENDING — Q18 surfaces this as a blocking question for v2

on_violation_detected: 1. STOP downstream consumption immediately if gate-grade violation (fail closed).
2. Bake gatekeeper alarm to r2d2:alarm:forbidden_merge:<rule_id>:<utc> with evidence.
3. Discord-ping Matt with rule violated, location, recommended action.
5. Request architect review before re-enabling boundary.
